demoMode: The six newer demos have a 'Demo mode (D)' button: press D (or click it) and drag the 'demo value' slider (or use the up/down arrow keys) to fake a sensor reading. No hardware needed.

demos.title: Breathing Exercise
demos.description: Breathe out onto the humidity sensor to inflate a balloon and follow a calm breathing rhythm.
howToTest: Plug in the humidity sensor.
Click the green flag and choose the sensor in the pop-up.
Set the breathing cycle slider, then click All Set!
Breathe slowly onto the sensor and watch the balloon rise. Stop breathing on it and the balloon sinks.
demos.challenge: Can you match the balloon to a 4-second-in, 4-second-out breath for one whole minute?

demos.title: Hungry Parrot
demos.description: Steer a parrot with light: cover the light sensor to fly down and uncover it to fly up. Catch the good strawberries and dodge the bad ones.
howToTest: Plug in the UV/light sensor and lay it face up on the table.
Click the green flag and choose the sensor in the pop-up.
Click All Set! (it measures the room's brightness first).
Move your hand over the sensor to steer the parrot.
demos.challenge: What is your best score? Does the game get easier or harder near a window?

demos.title: Hedgehog and Light
demos.description: A hedgehog sleeps in the dark and wakes up when the light gets bright, over your webcam picture.
howToTest: Plug in the UV/light sensor.
Click the green flag, allow the camera, and choose the sensor in the pop-up.
Cover the sensor: the hedgehog sleeps. Shine a torch on it: the hedgehog wakes up.
demos.challenge: Find the darkest spot in the room. How many lux does it take to wake the hedgehog?

demos.title: UV Graph over Video
demos.description: Draws a live line graph of the UV index over your webcam picture, with the lux value shown too.
howToTest: Plug in the UV/light sensor.
Click the green flag, allow the camera, and choose the sensor in the pop-up.
Point the sensor at a window or outside and watch the line climb.
demos.challenge: Is the UV index higher in the sun, in the shade, or behind a window? Graph all three.

demos.title: Smell Detector
demos.description: Sniffy the smell detector reacts to the air: fresh air, 'I smell something', or 'Phew!', with a big tVOC number and a 3-step meter.
howToTest: No sensor: click the green flag, press D, and drag the demo slider. Under 150 shows Fresh air, 150 to 599 shows Something smelly, 600 and up shows Phew!
With the VOC sensor: click the green flag, click Connect sensor and choose the sensor.
Wait about 15 seconds while the sensor warms up, then hold hand sanitiser or an orange peel near it.
demos.challenge: Rank five smells from weakest to strongest: orange peel, hand sanitiser, coffee, a marker pen and your breath.

demos.title: Salty Water Tester
demos.description: A light bulb shows whether water conducts electricity: off, dim or bright, with a big μS reading and three saved results to compare.
howToTest: No sensor: click the green flag, press D, and drag the slider. Under 2 μS the bulb is off, 2 to 99 it is dim, 100 and up it is bright. Press 1, 2 or 3 to save the reading.
With the conductivity sensor: click the green flag, click Connect sensor and choose the sensor.
Dip the probes in tap water and press 1, in salty water and press 2, in sugary water and press 3. Rinse the probes between cups.
demos.challenge: Add salt one pinch at a time. How many pinches until the bulb is bright? Does sugar ever make it light up?

demos.title: Hot or Cold?
demos.description: An infrared thermometer: point the sensor at things and see a coloured thermometer bar, a big °C number, and a COLD, WARM or HOT label with a sound.
howToTest: No sensor: click the green flag, press D, and drag the slider from -10 to 90. Under 18 shows COLD, 18 to 34 shows WARM, 35 and up shows HOT.
With the temperature sensor: click the green flag, click Connect sensor and choose the sensor.
Point it at an ice cube, your hand, and a warm drink.
demos.challenge: Which is warmer: your forehead or your fingertips? A dark or a light T-shirt left in the sun?

demos.title: Sunscreen Test
demos.description: Records the UV index through clear plastic, then again with sunscreen on the plastic, and works out what percentage of UV the sunscreen blocked.
howToTest: No sensor: click the green flag, press D, set the slider to 8 and press 1. Set it to 2 and press 2. It shows 75% blocked and Great protection!
With the UV sensor, outside or in strong sun: click the green flag, click Connect sensor and choose the sensor.
Hold clear plastic (a sandwich bag or a sheet protector) over the sensor and press 1. Rub a thin layer of sunscreen on the plastic and press 2.
demos.challenge: Test SPF 15 against SPF 50, or a thin layer against a thick one. Do sunglasses block UV too?

demos.title: Live Graph
demos.description: A live line graph of any sensor. It finds the sensor that is plugged in and scales itself, showing the highest and lowest readings and a big 'now' value.
howToTest: No sensor: click the green flag, press D, and move the slider. The line wiggles on its own, and moving the slider shifts it up and down.
With any sensor: click the green flag, click Connect sensor and choose the sensor. The graph picks the reading for you.
Keys 1-8 pick a reading (1 Lux, 2 UV, 3 Humidity, 4 IR temp, 5 Air temp, 6 Conductance, 7 tVOC, 8 CO2eq). Key 0 goes back to auto-detect, and C clears the graph.
demos.challenge: Breathe on the humidity sensor and graph it. How long does it take to go back to normal?

demos.title: Sensor Band
demos.description: Turns a sensor into a musical instrument: a higher reading plays a higher note, and coloured notes fly across the stage.
howToTest: No sensor: click the green flag, press D, and drag the slider. Low values play low notes and high values play high notes (turn the sound on).
With the UV/light sensor: click the green flag, click Connect sensor and choose the sensor, then wave your hand over it. It learns your darkest and brightest light. Press C to re-tune.
Keys 1-5 change the instrument: piano, marimba, flute, steel drum, synth.
demos.challenge: Can you play a tune from Twinkle Twinkle Little Star with only your hand and a torch?
